name: snatch pull
description: A snatch-grip pull from the floor. Extend the legs and hips powerfully and shrug at the top without moving under or catching the bar.
instructions: Stand over the bar with your feet about hip-width apart and take a wide snatch grip.
Brace your trunk, keep your back neutral, and push through the floor to bring the bar past your knees.
Keep the bar close as you powerfully extend your hips, knees, and ankles, then shrug your shoulders.
Stay above the bar; do not pull yourself underneath or catch it overhead.
Lower the bar under control and reset for the next rep.
